objective: Prove that the public GestionPisos / Allaiso PWA can be opened and inspected by the QA node without authentication or mutation.
preconditions: The GitHub Pages deployment is publicly reachable.
No authenticated session is required for this smoke.

steps.expect: The PWA entry point loads without browser-level navigation error.

steps.action: Read the page title and one visible heading without modifying the page.
steps.expect: The deployed PWA exposes readable semantic content.
Screenshot evidence is stored under the run evidence directory.

assertions: At least one visible semantic element was read.
diagnostics: If navigation fails, capture the browser error and stop.
If semantic inspection fails, capture the current page and stop.

safety.notes: Public read-only activation smoke. No login, form submission, or mutation.
